submission.natural_language_explanation: L4/N159+ fires on the token that closes a fused two-token unit, i.e. the second member of a chunk that names a single lexical item: a hyphen or prefix/particle compound (in-house, after-school, out-of-date, over|harvesting, run|ny, Port|ales) or a fixed preposition/particle-headed expression (in place, in mind, into play, into force, cut short, top out, at bay, end of). Both members are required (replacing the earlier token erases essentially the whole activation, and that earlier token never fires alone), while the same words as free compositional constituents (a place, take place, your mind, in order, in line, in which, of the, in house, farmhouse, on site) and the token after the completed unit stay at baseline; the output side carries no coherent next-token set (Jacobian kurtosis 3.06, 0% agreement with the logit lens), so this is retrospective chunk-detection, not lookahead.
